---
title: Build and Brainstorm
description: Build changes your site straight away. Brainstorm asks questions, drafts a plan, and builds once you approve it.
sidebar:
  order: 3
---

Every message you send runs in one of two modes. **Build** changes the site directly. **Brainstorm** asks you questions and makes a plan first. You choose the mode with the **Build** / **Brainstorm** toggle on **New agent**, and later with the chip in the chat box.

1. Click the chip at the bottom of the chat box. It shows the model and the mode, for example **Auto · Build**.
2. Under **Run mode** (**Choose how the agent works**), pick **Build** (**Changes it directly.**) or **Brainstorm** (**Asks, plans, then builds task by task.**).
3. Send your message. The hint in the box follows the mode: **Tell me what you want to build** for **Build**, and **Describe it — I'll ask a few questions first** for **Brainstorm**.

![The chip in the chat box opened: Select model with Auto, then Choose model, then Run mode with Build selected and Brainstorm below it.](/images/build/modes-1.webp)

## Build

The builder reads your request, changes the site, checks its work and tells you what it did. It does not write a plan or wait for approval, even for the first message. It looks at every App in the agent and decides which ones to change. The changes appear in Preview. The live site stays as it is until you **Publish**.

Use **Build** when you know what you want and the change is small or clear: a first small site like the coffee shop, a new page, a different heading, another opening time.

## Brainstorm

The builder asks you questions, in one or more rounds. It then drafts a plan and stops until you approve it. After you approve, it builds the plan task by task, checks each task, and finishes with a final review, ready to **Publish**. See [Approve the plan](/agent/approve-plan/) for how questions and plans work.

Use **Brainstorm** when the idea is still open, or the site is big enough to want a plan, for example a coffee shop that also takes orders and sends confirmation emails.

A small edit that only changes existing text, names, numbers, colors or images needs no plan. Even in **Brainstorm** the builder makes it at once.

## Good to know

- You can change the mode between messages, but not while the builder is working. The chip is greyed out until the turn ends.
- A **Brainstorm** build has its own controls, **Pause** and **Stop**, and its own progress. See [Follow progress](/build/progress/).
- You can start in **Build** and switch to **Brainstorm** later when a change turns out bigger than you thought.
